blocks.text: Cebu is evolving into an interconnected system of specialized cities, destinations, and gateways rather than a single market. Cebu City remains the metropolitan anchor, while Mandaue handles manufacturing and trade. Lapu-Lapu manages aviation, hospitality, and industry, as northern and southern municipalities gain commercial gravitas through public and private investment. In 2024, their combined economic output exceeded PHP 1.08 trillion. Backed by a population surpassing 5.23 million, this immense demographic depth fuels diverse regional real estate market segments.
